topic: byob: a local-first desktop AI agent, no Electron
title: byob: the desktop agent with no brain
description: byob is a local-first desktop AI agent with no Electron. Point it at the OpenAI-compatible endpoint you already run (llama-server, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM) and your local model gets hands: files, commands, spreadsheets. Working description; the package stage overwrites it.
hook_candidates: Three moves tonight, and your Ollama model builds a spreadsheet.
byob: bring your own brain. The desktop agent ships without one.
Your Ollama server finally gets hands. Thirteen megabytes of hands.
The desktop AI agent that refuses to ship a model.
A local AI agent that starts by finding your server.
Sixty megabytes, no Electron, no account. Bring your own brain.
Point a desktop agent at localhost. It already speaks your server's language.
Your local model can't touch your files. byob changes that tonight.
No Electron, no bundled model, no account. Just hands for your local model.
One week old, ten releases, zero bundled models.
narration_full: byob: bring your own brain. The desktop agent ships without one. Your Ollama stays the brain. You'd expect it to run the model. It never does. Thirteen megabytes of program: one client for any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, a server that speaks OpenAI's API shape. Yours is already listening. Once connected, it reads files, runs code, builds spreadsheets beside your chat. Its predecessor hob bundled llama.cpp, the whole engine. byob drops even Electron, the bundled browser most agents ship. Tonight: cargo install byob, or unpack the release: about sixty megabytes of download. Launch it with one flag at your server, then press Test connection. A week old, solo-built, seven stars, an empty issue tracker. No bundled brain, no bundled browser: your model grows hands tonight.
